Healthcare pay by kind of job: the hourly rates open jobs post, as of 2026-10-19 (USD, before shift differentials and bonuses):
- Registered Nurses & LPNs: median $45/hr, typical $40 to $80/hr (21,465 rates at 515 employers, 97,460 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/nurses#pay
- Nurse Practitioners & Physician Assistants: median $75/hr, typical $65 to $170/hr (1,629 rates at 169 employers, 14,140 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/nurse-practitioners#pay
- Physicians & Surgeons: median $145/hr, typical $50 to $300/hr (682 rates at 147 employers, 20,294 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/physicians#pay
- Nursing Assistants & Patient Care Techs: median $20/hr, typical $20 to $30/hr (4,181 rates at 334 employers, 16,107 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/nursing-assistants#pay
- Caregivers & Home Health Aides: median $19/hr, typical $17 to $25/hr (1,991 rates at 249 employers, 6,963 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/caregivers#pay
- Physical, Occupational, Speech & Respiratory Therapy: median $45/hr, typical $40 to $75/hr (5,539 rates at 342 employers, 38,474 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/therapy-rehab#pay
- Mental Health & Social Work: median $30/hr, typical $25 to $70/hr (3,445 rates at 393 employers, 19,397 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/mental-health#pay
- Pharmacists & Pharmacy Techs: median $35/hr, typical $25 to $95/hr (2,231 rates at 200 employers, 12,442 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/pharmacy#pay
- Radiology & Imaging Techs: median $45/hr, typical $40 to $75/hr (5,059 rates at 259 employers, 20,853 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/imaging#pay
- Lab Techs & Phlebotomists: median $30/hr, typical $25 to $65/hr (2,638 rates at 212 employers, 11,065 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/lab#pay
- Surgical Techs & Sterile Processing: median $35/hr, typical $30 to $55/hr (1,514 rates at 165 employers, 5,029 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/surgical-techs#pay
- EMTs & Paramedics: median $25/hr, typical $25 to $45/hr (487 rates at 97 employers, 1,948 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/emts-paramedics#pay
- Medical Assistants: median $25/hr, typical $20 to $35/hr (3,024 rates at 289 employers, 9,776 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/medical-assistants#pay
- Dentists, Hygienists & Dental Assistants: median $30/hr, typical $25 to $60/hr (1,051 rates at 85 employers, 4,847 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/dental#pay
- Patient Access, Coding & Medical Admin: median $25/hr, typical $20 to $40/hr (4,458 rates at 443 employers, 14,969 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/admin#pay
- More Allied Health: median $35/hr, typical $25 to $60/hr (1,761 rates at 230 employers, 7,730 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/allied-health#pay
- AI Training for Health Professionals: median $75/hr, typical $60 to $200/hr (89 rates at 8 programs, 173 open jobs). Page: https://carejobs.now/roles/ai-training#pay
Every open job together: typical $25 to $80/hr, median $40/hr (61,244 rates at 915 employers; 214,164 of the 301,667 open jobs post no hourly rate).
Typical pay is the 25th percentile of what jobs pay (the middle of each advertised range) to the 90th-percentile advertised ceiling. Method: https://carejobs.now/methodology. Data: https://carejobs.now/pay.json (CC BY 4.0, credit CareJobs.Now).
